meta.parameter: configured active reliable DATA packet limit
meta.peak_scope: whole endpoint lifetime including warmup/drain; span is distinct from active packet count
meta.actual_loss_scope: whole trial random drops / offers eligible after queue/blackout drops, independently per direction; includes ACKs/retries
meta.partial_crc_payload_scope: CRC-valid complete-record prefix payload / configured measurement duration; excludes incomplete records and is not whole-stream verification
meta.qualification: Provisional; no accepted calibration receipt. Latency is observed transport probe RTT, not desktop latency.

metric_subsets.qualified: COMPLETE, full CRC/hash/order integrity, valid timing/endpoint/flight evidence
metric_subsets.integrity_valid: full integrity plus valid timing/health; probe-only FAIL remains a failure
metric_subsets.diagnostic: all intact observations; timing-invalid full-integrity rates are diagnostics; partial CRC-prefix rate is separate

flight_loss25.description: 10 Mbit/s in each direction with 25% independent datagram loss; fixed jitter and delay

flight_loss70.description: 10 Mbit/s in each direction with 70% independent datagram loss; fixed jitter and delay

notes: Configured inflight DATA packet counts are 16/32/48/64; byte queue 128KiB fixed on both endpoints.
Each endpoint opts into protocol LogWindow 7; fixed peer always uses configured 64.
Records 16KiB, probe payload 64bytes, protocol wire MTU 1232; actual max DATA payload comes from endpoint telemetry.
Loss applies independently in both directions to all datagrams, including ACKs and retransmissions.
The zero-loss control keeps the same 15ms one-way delay, ±1ms jitter, 10Mbit/s cap and 30ms queue.
Native reliable UDP2 transport only; no TLS/RDP setup/Windows/rendering.
Every attempt retained; no failed condition is retried to obtain a passing sample.
No accepted calibration receipt is created by this runner; independent raw UDP checks are calibration-only.
Serial timing; report progress is updated only after a completed trial, between measured windows.
